title: Harbison Protection Contracts Terms: Cancellation by the Holder
content:
**Condition 1. The holder's decision.** Cancelling a Harbison Protection Contracts contract is the holder's own decision: the agent records a cancellation request and the holder confirms it, and the cancellation takes effect on the date of confirmation. A cancellation takes effect only once the holder has confirmed a cancellation request on the contract, as the contract's change requests show.

**Condition 2. Which tiers can be cancelled.** Only tiers that allow cancellation can be cancelled; the included workmanship warranty cannot.

**Condition 3. Full refund.** A full refund of the contract price is given only when the holder gives notice of this cancellation no later than the tier's full-refund days, in calendar days, after the contract was purchased, and no claim payout has been made on the contract. Refund-window days are counted as calendar days with the purchase date as day 0, and notice on the last day qualifies. Both parts are read from the records: the contract's purchase date and its claim history.

**Condition 4. Refund outside the full-refund case.** The former clause — "Otherwise the refund is the contract price multiplied by the unused full months of the coverage term divided by the term's months (labor coverage years times twelve), rounded to the cent half up, less every claim payout made on the contract and less the cancellation administrative fee, and never below zero" — is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current refund basis.

**Condition 5. Pending contracts.** A contract still pending is cancelled on the same terms and counts its full term as unused.

**Condition 6. How the refund is paid.** The refund posts as a cancellation refund credit naming the contract-price charge, or, for a tier bought on the installation contract, naming no charge on this contract, and the resulting credit balance is paid out to the original payment method. The aftermarket inspection fee is never refunded.

**Full-refund window (hypothetical, 60 full-refund days).**

| Purchase date (day 0) | Notice given | Claim payout made | Full refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April 2026 | 9 June 2026 (day 60) | none | yes |
| 10 April 2026 | 10 June 2026 (day 61) | none | no |
| 10 April 2026 | 15 May 2026 | one payout | no |

superseded_clauses: Otherwise the refund is contract_price multiplied by the unused full months of the coverage term divided by the term's months (labor_coverage_years times twelve), rounded to the cent half up, less every claim payout made on the contract and less cancellation_admin_fee_usd, and never below zero.
